{{Quote|Welcome to Florrum!|Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>}}
'''Florrum''' was a rocky, backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] from [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
[[File:Skalder_Squad.png|thumb|left|200px|Skalders being ridden by Jar Jar Binks and clones.]]
Florrum had a [[Temperature/Legends|dry]] climate and the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a mixture of [[Desert/Legends|deserts]], canyons and areas with many [[Doshar fields/Legends|sulfuric geysers]]. [[Skalder/Legends|Skalders]] were creatures native to the Doshar fields with thick hides that protected them from the [[Acid/Legends|acid]] coming out of the [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]]. Other [[Species/Legends|species]] living on Florrum were [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] and [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].

==History==
===Capture of Dooku===
A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] had its [[Hondo's complex/Legends|headquarters]] located on Florrum. After their capture of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], they returned to the planet with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]].<ref name="DC" /> Later it was there that Ohnaka captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after they came to check that Dooku was there to pay the [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] for [[Gender/Legends|him]]. They [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|escaped]] soon after, with the help of [[Senator/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Binks]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The planet was then left in peace by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], but Kenobi told Ohnaka that Dooku did not have the same honor and knew where Ohnaka was.<ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>

===Boba Fett's Arrival===
<div style="float:right">[[File:Florrum_settlements.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] settlements on the surface.]]</div>
Following an [[Mission to Vanqor/Legends|incident]] in which [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], alongside fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Castas/Legends|Castas]], took [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hostages in the aftermath of an [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|attack]] as part of Boba Fett's revenge scheme against [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], the need to take shelter on a distant planet arose. Sing therefore commandeered [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]] and landed on Florrum to seek the aid of Hondo Ohnaka, whom Aurra Sing wanted to replace Castas, due to his desire to quit the mission. While Ohnaka allowed the group and their captives, among them [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]], to take refuge with his gang, he refused to aid them in their endeavors. Meanwhile, Boba Fett was becoming increasingly disillusioned with Sing's methods, most especially after she killed Castas when he attempted to turn the other bounty hunters in. Shortly thereafter, [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on Florrum in pursuit of the bounty hunters, having heard Castas' message to his underworld friends back on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After a brief skirmish in Ohnaka's cantina, Sing escaped the Jedi, leaving Boba Fett to be captured. Ahsoka pursued Sing, while Ohnaka convinced Fett that assisting the Jedi would be the honorable thing to do. While attempting to escape aboard Slave I, Sing was seemingly killed when the ship crashed as a result of Ahsoka's efforts. Boba Fett and Bossk were then taken back to Coruscant by the Jedi, and the hostages were freed. Unbeknownst to them, however, Ohnaka had managed to retrieve Aurra Sing from the wreckage of Slave I, allowing her to survive and undertake future missions.

===Crash landing===
Shortly after [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and his accomplices broke [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] out of Galactic Republic imprisonment, [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], one of Cad Bane's accomplices, was [[Battle of Florrum|caught in a battle]] over Florrum, while trying to hide from the Republic in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. A [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]], which was under attack by a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and several [[Droid starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], shot [[Shahan Alama's Flarestar-class attack shuttle|Alama's saucer craft]] down. Shahan was forced to make an emergency landing on Florrum's rocky surface, where he met Hondo Ohnaka and was captured by him.<ref name="Hunting">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref>

===Rescue Mission===
Later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] planned to rescue their chaperon, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], after she was kidnapped by Hondo and his pirates<ref name="BFR" /> following a [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|raid]] the pirates conducted on their [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]], the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']].<ref name="ATOS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> Once landed on Florrum's surface, the younglings go scout for the pirates, but instead find a [[Circus/Legends|circus]] vessel led by [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]]. They impress the circus leader with their stunts and acts and join his [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|circus]]. While preforming at Hondo's base, they managed to free Ahsoka and escape the outpost.<ref name="BFR" />

===Second battle of Florrum===
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], under the orders of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] Dooku, launched an attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet for control over the Florrum system. The Separatists were victorious and Kenobi and the surviving members of his crew were forced to flee. Kenobi and [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] activated their ship's self destruct system just before they fled. Grievous then lead a ground assault on Florrum where they easily took over the pirate stronghold and held Ohnaka and his men captive. Some of Ohnaka's men, along with Ahsoka and the younglings, managed to infiltrate the base and free him and the rest of the pirates. Ohnaka then fled to [[Hondo's secret ship vault/Legends|his secret starship vault]] with his men and was ready to leave Florrum, but at the urging of one of the younglings, piloted [[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]] and rescued Ahsoka and the other younglings. Ohnaka and his men then returned to Florrum after returning Ahsoka and the younglings to Kenobi.
